title: Role-based access control (RBAC) will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
body:
Role-based access control (RBAC) will be available by default for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled in mid-September 2026.

RBAC lets users assume a role in Databricks. When a user assumes a role, only that role's permissions apply, rather than the user's accumulated permissions. This enables exclusive access. Users must actively assume a role to access sensitive data, preventing them from accessing it under their own identity and from mixing data across use cases, clinical trials, projects, or clients.

See [Role-based access control (RBAC)](/aws/en/security/auth/rbac).
